details.db: real PostgreSQL via testcontainers; alembic upgrade heads applied migration iam_0007_totp_and_magic_link successfully
proved: migration 0007 applies cleanly on a fresh migrated DB (pure-CREATE: totp_credentials + totp_backup_codes + magic_link_tokens)
TOTP secret at-rest is CIPHERTEXT: SELECT secret_encrypted FROM iam.totp_credentials — base32 secret is NOT a substring of the stored bytea
full 2FA flow: enroll -> confirm (10 backup codes) -> login returns two_factor_required (no tokens) -> login/totp with a live code issues a pair; wrong code 401
backup code single-use: accepted once as second factor, replay -> 401
magic-link: request 202 (anti-enum; no email for unknown account) -> consume issues a pair -> replay of consumed token -> 410

session isolation: user sees only own sessions (current flagged); cross-user revoke -> 404 with the other user's session row untouched (revoked_at IS NULL); revoke-all-others keeps exactly the caller's session active
details.role_context: requests run as oriion_app (SET LOCAL ROLE) — the prod non-superuser role, so RLS/grant behavior on the new tables is exercised as in production
